text: Implemented shared modern/legacy FreeSurfer scalar morphometry decoder, bounded-size JVM reader with hemisphere check, and explicit underlay polarity/window/palette preserving legacy default. Verified 128 surface JVM + 101 surface JS tests and 60 view JVM + 60 view JS tests. Four real fields bound to reviewed MNI geometry match independent decoded float64 digests exactly; desktop test compilation passes.
